difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism f : X -> Y with Y irreducible of generic point eta, a nonempty generic fibre X_eta forces the existence of a nonempty open V in Y such that X_V -> V is surjective. The retained proof gives the reduction explicitly: upon taking affine opens the claim follows from Algebra, lemma-characterize-image-finite-type; the author adds that generic flatness would also imply it. Retained author proof at lines 6517-6521.
